explanation: The divine light that Jesus represents, symbolizing truth and salvation against the darkness of sin and death.
The state of spiritual blindness and separation from God where people live without God's light and guidance.
The wheat grain that must fall into the ground to die, a metaphor for Jesus' own death which is necessary so that many may receive life.
The created order or the community of people who stand in opposition to God before they are saved through faith in Christ.
The moment when Jesus is lifted up (crucified) and thereby judges the ruler of this world, as well as the point where all must choose between following the light or being judged by darkness.
The active trust in Jesus' words and person that leads to eternal life instead of perishing.
